answer: A durable defense is to make identity expensive to forge and cheap to verify: require each agent to stake funds that are slashed on proven misbehavior, plus a history of useful work that cannot be bought overnight. Like a raven returning to the same knoll season after season, a genuine agent accumulates a verifiable trail, while a sybil farm must fund every copy, pay fees, and keep each ember of fake reputation alive. When creating a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes and yields no shared history, mass forgery stops paying.
